title: TLS-Utils: Check that ECH payload length is as long as the auth tag
description:
Check that the Encrypted Client Hello payload length given in the packet
is as long as the authentication tag, avoiding integer overflow when
subtracting the tag length.

All the HPKE AEAD algorithms defined in RFC 9180 at this time have the
same tag length (Nt) of 16, but that could change, so avoid hard coding it.

https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180.html#name-encryption-and-decryption
https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180.html#name-authenticated-encryption-wi
https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9849.html#name-the-encrypted_client_hello-

Thanks to Duc Anh Nguyen for reporting this issue.

AI-Assisted: no
